SINDH MINISTERS
(SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XXIII 2002
An Ordinance to
amend the Sindh Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 15th July, 2002]
No. S. Legis. I(23)/2002,
dated 15-7-2002.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is
hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.---This Ordinance may be called the Sindh Ministers (Salaries,
Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.

ORDINANCE XXIII 2002
An Ordinance to
amend the Sindh Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 15th July, 2002]
No. S. Legis. I(23)/2002,
dated 15-7-2002.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is
hereby published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 5 of
Act VIII of 1975.---It shall come into force at once and shall be deemed to
have taken effect on and from 1st December, 2001.
(2) In the Sindh Ministers
(Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975 hereinafter referred to as the
said Act, in section 5, for the words "Twenty one thousand", the
words "thirty two thousand" and for the words "eighteen
thousand", the words "twenty seven thousand" shall, be
substituted.

ORDINANCE XXIII 2002
An Ordinance to
amend the Sindh Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 15th July, 2002]
No. S. Legis. I(23)/2002,
dated 15-7-2002.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is
hereby published for general information:--
3. Amendment of the section 7
of Act VIII of 1975.---In the said Act, in section 7, for subsection (2),
the following shall be substituted:-
"(2) Where a Minister is not
provided with an official residence or prefers to reside in his own house or a
private residence, he shall be paid thirty five thousand rupees per mensem and
shall, in addition, be paid a sum of sixty thousand rupees for furnishing the
house only once whether he is appointed Minister or elected as Speaker or
Deputy Speaker for any number of occasion either during the first tenure of the
Assembly after the tenth day of March, 1985, or on election of a new
Assembly.".
